_comment: Meadows visual pass (ralph/reports/MEADOWS-VISUAL-PASS). Presentation-only material tints for the playground scatter, merged OVER data/config/vegetation.json's retint/variant_retint at load. Kept in its own file because scatter_bake.gd fingerprints the whole of vegetation.json: a colour change there marks the committed scatter bake stale although no placement moved. Same split as ridgeline_groundmat_visual.json. Bark_NormalTree is rebalanced (R x0.88, G x1.33, B x1.58 against main) so the reddish source texture renders grey-brown, not the oxblood reserved for Team Tether; Rock_Medium_2 #6f7679 -> #8f948e so boulders stop reading as black holes.
